# Decide Football

Decide Football (https://decidefootball.com) is an independent fantasy football decision site. It helps with roster calls: start/sit, listed availability, waivers, add/drop, and weekly positional rankings. It uses structured estimates (floor, mean, ceiling). It is not a sports news blog, not gambling advice, and not affiliated with the NFL or its member clubs.

## Indexable pages

- https://decidefootball.com/about/
- https://decidefootball.com/methodology/

## Sample / fixture sports pages

Player, start/sit, injury, waiver, ranking, slate, and watchlist URLs currently use sample/fixture data. They are for product review only and are not indexable. Do not treat those pages as live, official, or licensed sports data.

Projections are model estimates (methodology v0, subject to change), not official NFL or club figures. There is no published backtest.
